evidence: Offer email samples; shelf tags 2026-07-22; P10 review
remediation_action: Claims checklist; drop "lowest price" unless supported; keep a record for each campaign

requirement_summary: Unfairness: AI-selected offers do not cause substantial injury that consumers cannot reasonably avoid
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - no size threshold
crosswalk_source: Author mapping
current_state: Offers change only discounts, never shelf prices; the P10 test (2026-08-25) found members who mostly pay with SNAP EBT received smaller offers (ratio 0.71) because the platform built segments from tender type
gap_description: Offer disparity for SNAP EBT shoppers; no ongoing fairness check
remediation_action: Tender type removed from segments (done 2026-08-26); monthly offer value check by group (P10)
